title: Best Old School Tattoo in Hanoi Old Quarter: Bold Lines That Last a Lifetime
description: ​If you are searching for the best Old School tattoo in Hanoi Old Quarter, understanding what makes this style special—and choosing a trusted, hygienic studio—is key to getting ink you will love forever.
content:
​Walking through the historic streets of Hanoi’s Old Quarter, you will find a vibrant blend of ancient culture and modern street art. For travelers looking to take home a permanent souvenir, Old School (American Traditional) tattoos remain one of the most iconic, timeless choices.

​Why Old School Tattoos Are the Ultimate Travel Souvenir

​Unlike delicate fine-line designs that may fade over time, American Traditional tattoos are built to last. The style is famous for three defining traits:

​Bold, Solid Black Outlines: Strong linework holds the structure of the tattoo crisp and legible for decades.

​Vibrant, Saturated Color Palettes: Focusing on classic reds, yellows, greens, and deep blacks with high contrast that pops on every skin tone.

​Timeless Storytelling Symbols: Anchors, swallows, roses, panthers, and daggers carry classic meanings of freedom, protection, and adventure.

​What Travelers Should Look for in a Hanoi Tattoo Studio

​Hanoi has hundreds of tattoo shops, especially around Hoan Kiem District. When getting inked abroad, international travelers should prioritize these essentials:

​Strict International Hygiene Standards: Ensure the studio uses 100% single-use, sterilized needles, medical-grade disinfectants, and high-quality imported inks.

​Steady Linework & Color Packing: Old School looks simple, but any shaky line or patchy color is immediately visible. Always check the artist’s portfolio.

​Clear English Communication: You want an artist who understands your exact vision and can customize classic flash designs to fit your journey.

​Mr. Tattoo Hanoi Studio: Authentic Ink in the Heart of the Old Quarter

​Established in 2010, Mr. Tattoo Hanoi Studio has spent over a decade earning the trust of international travelers and local tattoo enthusiasts alike. Guided by the slogan "Tattoo your journey in Hanoi," the studio focuses on turning your travel memories into custom, durable body art.

​Why Travelers Choose Mr. Tattoo Hanoi:

​Prime Old Quarter Location: Conveniently situated at 2nd Floor, 106 Hang Buom Street, Hoan Kiem, just steps away from Ta Hien Street and Hoan Kiem Lake. 

​Mastery of Bold & Custom Styles: Whether you want a classic American Traditional flash piece, a custom Old School design, or bold blackwork, every tattoo is drawn and executed with precision.

​100% Sterile & Traveler-Friendly: Single-use equipment opened right in front of you, English-speaking artists, and clear communication.

​Walk-Ins & Custom Appointments: Short on time in Hanoi? Both walk-in sessions and advance consultations are available.

​Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

​How much does an Old School tattoo cost in Hanoi?

​Tattoo prices in Hanoi are generally very reasonable. Small Old School flash tattoos usually start around $40–$70 USD, while medium-sized custom color pieces range from $100–$250+ USD depending on detail and placement.

​Do I need to book an appointment in advance?

​For smaller flash designs, walk-ins are always welcome at 106 Hang Buom. However, if you have a custom concept or limited time, messaging us ahead of time is recommended.

​Ready to Tattoo Your Journey in Hanoi?

​Whether you are marking a solo trip, a milestone adventure, or simply love the timeless look of American Traditional ink, stop by for a free consultation.

title: Best Asian Style Tattoo Shop in Hanoi Old Quarter – Mr. Tattoo Hanoi Studio
description: ​If you are traveling through Vietnam and looking for the best Asian style tattoo shop in Hanoi Old Quarter, you want an artist who truly understands the soul, symbolism, and flow of Oriental art.
content:
Located at 2nd Floor, 106 Hang Buom Street, Mr. Tattoo Hanoi Studio has been crafting authentic Asian, Oriental, and Vietnamese traditional tattoos since 2012.

​True to our motto, "Tattoo your journey in Hanoi," we help travelers turn Eastern philosophy, folklore, and local heritage into timeless body art.

​The Art of Asian & Vietnamese Traditional Tattoos

​Asian tattooing is more than just ink on skin—it is a storytelling tradition built on balance, movement, and deep cultural meaning. Unlike generic flash designs, an authentic Oriental piece is drawn to flow naturally with the anatomy of your body.

​At Mr. Tattoo Hanoi Studio, our artists specialize in a wide range of Asian tattoo traditions:

​Vietnamese Cultural & Heritage Tattoos: Dong Son bronze drum patterns, lotus flowers, traditional bamboo, water buffaloes, and iconic Hanoi landmarks.

​Oriental Mythical Creatures: Eastern dragons, phoenixes, Koi fish, Foo Dogs (guardian lions), and cranes—each representing strength, resilience, prosperity, or harmony.

​Asian Brushwork & Sumi-e Style: Expressive ink-wash strokes inspired by classical East Asian calligraphy and landscape painting.

​Micro & Fine Line Asian Art: Delicate, modern interpretations of Eastern symbols—perfect for travelers wanting a subtle yet meaningful souvenir.

​Custom Full-Sleeve & Back Pieces: Large-scale traditional compositions engineered with dynamic wind bars, water waves, and clouds.

​Why Mr. Tattoo Hanoi Studio Stands Out in the Old Quarter

​Choosing the right studio for an Asian-style tattoo in Hanoi makes all the difference. Here is why international travelers consider us a top destination in the Old Quarter:

​Deep Cultural Understanding: Born and raised in Hanoi, our artists understand the authentic stories and symbolism behind every Eastern motif—ensuring your tattoo is culturally respectful and accurate.

​Over 14 Years of Experience (Est. 2012): More than a decade of dedicated tattoo artistry in the heart of Hanoi.

​Custom-Drawn Artwork: Every Asian piece is custom-designed around your idea, body placement, and desired level of detail.

​100% Medical-Grade Hygiene: We strictly use brand-new, single-use sterilized needles, disposable tubes, and authentic imported inks for every session.

​Clear English Consultation: We walk you through the meaning of each symbol, design layout, and aftercare steps in clear English before the needle touches your skin.

​Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

​Can I get a small Asian-style tattoo in a single session during my trip?

Yes! While full sleeves take multiple sessions, we create many medium and small Asian designs—such as lotus flowers, calligraphy, small dragons, or Vietnamese cultural motifs—that can be completed in 1 to 3 hours.

​Do you help design custom Asian tattoos based on a concept?

Absolutely. Tell us the meaning or story you want to capture (such as luck, protection, family, or your journey in Vietnam), and our artists will sketch a custom design tailored to you.

​How much does an Asian tattoo cost at Mr. Tattoo Hanoi Studio?

Small Asian souvenir tattoos start from $10–$30, while larger custom Oriental pieces are priced based on size, placement, and session time. Send us your reference ideas for an exact quote before your visit.
